source_tree_files: all .py files of the code folder that ran the exporter; it describes the code of the commit that contains this manifest
provenance_note: The production runs of runs_v2.sh, runs_barkley_v2.sh and runs_refine.sh predate per-run source digests; their code_revision fields read 'unknown' or are absent. Their production commit was identified afterwards: its simulation modules are byte-identical (up to line ends) to the files that ran, all of which were last modified before the runs started. The runs of runs_revision.sh record the digest of the simulation modules that ran (code_revision 'tree:<digest>', listed per run; the straight-filament and Panfilov-Rudenko ring runs record none).
note: hashes are of the bytes as written; data/ is stored with -text in git
